en: The image shows the address side of an old Russian postcard. It features printed bilingual headings in Russian and French, a red Imperial Russian postage stamp with a double‑headed eagle, several circular postmarks dated 1904, handwritten address text in Russian cursive, and a handwritten Latin‑alphabet signature at the bottom. There is no photograph or illustration visible on this side, only text, stamps, and postal markings.
